messages:
incident-bot: Pager: p99 latency spike on /v1/chat (chat-completions) observed across eu-west for model group "fast-chat". Alerting count: 8 p99 breaches in last 5m, customers seeing slow responses. Root ts: 2061234567
maria.khan: seeing it too. P95 still okay-ish but p99 shot up to ~2.8s for a subset of routes. Any deploys?
kevin.lee: no deploys from infra. Spawned new GPU nodes earlier but they're green. Could be model degradation or a routing hot-spot.
ajay.singh: marking as page. I'm taking first responder. @incident-bot can you attach the per-route build?
incident-bot: attached metrics: https://grafana.redwood/boards/abc123 - looks concentrated on routes with header X-Model: fast-chat and routes tagged "interactive". Also uplift in tail latency on Dedicated customer cs-197.
june: cs-197 reported increased end-user latency; support ticket open: #T-5129. Customer impact: UI timeouts on chat send for ~3% sessions.
kevin.lee: mitigation option 1: temporary fallback to compat-fast model (lower quality) for the affected routes. Option 2: increase autoscale/shard capacity for those route tags.
ajay.singh: can we enable fallback per-route? I think the router supports per-route fallback to compat-fast with code change + runtime switch.
maria.khan: quick mitigation: enable KV cache warmup + reduce batch window from 50ms to 20ms for these routes — should lower p99 for taily workloads.
opsbot: Runbook step: enable fallback for route tag "interactive" -> /ops/fallback --run
ajay.singh: executing fallback now. Will also squelch p99 alert for the route to avoid noisy pages while mitigation is active. Recording action: squelch-2061234567 by ajay.singh
kevin.lee: after fallback p99 is down to ~1.1s on sample traffic. P95 unchanged. Looks effective.
june: customer cs-197 still seeing occasional spikes but overall improved. I'll update ticket and note the temporary fallback.
maria.khan: for post-incident we should: 1) propose new per-route baselines for p95/p99 (interactive routes are more bursty), 2) add a dedicated dashboard panel for route tag percentiles, 3) implement noise-gating + dynamic thresholding tied to moving average.
ajay.singh: agree. Draft alert rule snippet:
```
alert: ChatRouteP99
expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_latency_seconds_bucket{route_tag="interactive"}[5m])) by (le)) > 1.5
for: 5m
labels: { severity: "page" }
annotations: { runbook: "//ops/runbooks/chat-p99" }
```
maria.khan: note threshold 1.5s here is for interactive; global p99 stays at 2.0s. We'll apply per-route overrides for high-burst routes.
kevin.lee: also recommend adding a 'recent-deploy' tag to alerts to suppress post-deploy noise and a 'capacity-surge' temporary mute window when autoscale triggers.
ajay.singh: creating a follow-up ticket for eng-platform: "per-route p95/p99 baselines + dashboard + alert gating". Ticket: EP-3128.
june: handoff: I'm taking night-oncall for follow-up. Ajay, please add all logs + timeline into EP-3128 and set assignee to eng-platform.
ajay.singh: done, added timeline and links. Squelch will auto-expire in 2h, fallback remains enabled until platform changes are rolled out. Moving to close on page.
incident-bot: Page resolved. Duration: 34m. Actions: fallback enabled, p99 squelch, EP-3128 created.
kevin.lee: postmortem note: include cost impact estimate for fallback (higher ops cost) and a proposed long-term fix: routing rebalancer to avoid hot routes.
maria.khan: agreed. I'll draft RCA and propose changes to alerting playbook in next oncall review.
